requirements.title: EXTERNAL procedure names resolve to pointer targets, dummy effective arguments, or external procedures
requirements.definition: For a name with the EXTERNAL attribute, a procedure pointer reference is to its target, a nonpointer dummy procedure reference is to the corresponding effective argument, and any other reference is to the external procedure with that name.

pending.external-procedure-pointer-target-select: Associate procedure pointer p with module function target returning 31, call p(), and verify 31 rather than an external p companion returning 99.
pending.external-dummy-effective-argument-select: Pass module function actual returning 41 to a nonpointer dummy procedure d declared EXTERNAL; inside the callee call d() and verify 41 rather than a same-named external fallback 99.
pending.external-procedure-name-selected: Declare integer external abs returning x+49; reference ABS(-7) and verify 42, distinguishing it from intrinsic ABS result 7.

requirements.title: Accessible specific procedure names resolve to the accessible procedure
requirements.definition: A name of an accessible external procedure, internal procedure, module procedure, intrinsic procedure, or statement function resolves to that procedure.

pending.accessible-external-procedure-selected: Call an accessible external function f returning 42 through an explicit interface; companion internal f returning 99 is placed in a different scope.
pending.accessible-internal-procedure-selected: Call an internal function f returning 42 and verify exact result in a variable initialized to -1.
pending.accessible-module-procedure-selected: USE a module function f returning 42 and verify f()=42.
pending.accessible-intrinsic-procedure-selected: Declare INTRINSIC IABS and verify IABS(-42)=42 exactly.
pending.statement-function-selected: Define statement function f(i)=i+1 and verify f(41)=42.
